title: Choice Overload and Decision Making: A Review
snippet: This review examines when larger assortments increase decision difficulty and when they do not. Effects depend on task and context; claims about a universal ideal number require careful qualification.

title: The Paradox of Choice: Context and Consumer Decisions
snippet: Researchers describe how assortment size, decision goals, and comparison demands interact. The source cautions against treating choice overload as an inevitable effect.

title: Choice Overload Explained
snippet: A secondary overview of decision complexity and choices.
